sources.en_wiki: Black Clover Wiki (blackclover.fandom.com), English. The host is not reachable from the build machine, so the text was read from the repo's own snapshot of the wiki pages (the .github/wiki folder: the attribute pages and the spell pages, intro and description) and from the search summaries of the live pages. Quoted facts are the wiki's; nothing was invented.
sources.design: Order and thresholds of acquisition decided by this mod from the arcs and the strength of the spell: the sources give no chapter or episode for them. See docs/magic/character_spells_rest.md.

spells.name: Soul Magic (touching the head to seize the soul)
spells.note: The search summaries: his Soul Magic needs a touch on the target's head.

spells.name: Soul Magic (severing the soul)
spells.note: Design: the wiki lists Soul Magic spells only as unnamed.

spells.name: Soul Magic: Paladin Conversion
spells.note: KEPT page, locked to Lucius since 1.44.0: he turns people into his Paladins by remaking their souls.

spells.name: Soul Magic: Paladin Recall
spells.note: KEPT page, locked to Lucius since 1.44.0: he calls his Paladins back.

planned.name: Bone Bullets, Time Magic, Gravity, Body, Blood
planned.note: Attributes he gained later by absorbing his siblings and a contract; each lives in its own book.

planned.name: Clone creation (Soul, Body, Blood and Bone together)
planned.note: A union of four attributes; no page.

notes: His CanonBook entry changed from Dark Magic to Soul Magic (the series' attribute; the mod has a Soul book since 1.44.0): a grimoire already bound with the old pair (DARK, lucius) keeps working as before. Soul Magic has no named spells on the wiki, so only the two Paladin pages are canon; the other pages are marked design.
